en.install: Install Cursor Agents from Settings → Agent plugins in ShowAI, reload the window and start a local chat. For a manual install, place the plugin directory under `~/.cursor/plugins/local/` and check Customize → MCPs.
en.features: Show interactive previews and page cards in chat. Open the card’s live edit link in Cursor Browser to edit the original.

zh.install: 在 ShowAI 的「设置 → Agent 插件 → Cursor Agents」安装插件，重载窗口并新建本机对话。手动安装时将插件目录放入 `~/.cursor/plugins/local/`，在 Customize → MCPs 检查连接。
zh.features: 聊天内显示交互预览和原页卡片。卡片提供实时编辑链接，可在 Cursor Browser 中打开原页。
